benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The |J|-max, Fiedler, union, quarter-pi, and classical-popcount rounds are not rerun and their verdicts are not edited.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..105 were used in earlier rounds, except that k=100 and k=101 are the round-1 held-out instances and are not used. 118 and above stay unused.
forbidden: an energy-only union of two packings
a pi/4 or pi/2 shell displacement
using fidelity or a quantum eigenvector to score, start, or select

families.nodata: standard shared-gamma search, interleaved, present only so K can nest. Not the claim.
families.K: standard shared-gamma search, interleaved, present only so KM can nest. Not the claim.
families.KM: original shared-gamma KM, interleaved triples, 3+3L. Standard starts, then the repulsion escape.
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-4 standard starts, two repeats, no escape

packing: interleaved triples [[a, a+N/3, a+2N/3] for a in 0..N/3). The same partition at every layer and at every N. FK = J@J with zero diagonal, rms-normalized. FM = block means on these triples.
escape: After the standard starts at a depth, phi is the energy-best KM state so far at that depth. Three starts copy that vector's shells exactly. esc_signflip negates thetaK and thetaM. esc_swap exchanges thetaK and thetaM. esc_headkick adds N(0,1) to (gamma, thetaK, thetaM) only, seed [20261294, N, k, L, r]. Each start minimizes E + 1 * |<phi|psi>|^2 with L-BFGS-B. The best true energy visited on that path is kept. A pure-energy polish then starts from the penalized minimizer. Selection never uses the penalty or a fidelity.
architecture: cavity X frame, one gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM, three shell angles per layer, same UcX at every layer.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]
optimizer: L-BFGS-B, analytic adjoint gradient. Standard runs and the polish use true energy. Repulsion runs use true energy plus the frozen penalty. No classical penalty on the parameters.

seeds.note: Standard starts use the round-4 integer prefixes. The head kick uses its own prefix. family_index is the position in family_order. k=100 and k=101 are not used.

continuation: Zhou interpolation, time-rescaled shared coefficients, perturbations 0.1 and 0.3, two ramps, and for QAOA the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05). KM parents include escape rows from the previous depth. No third repeat.
selection: lowest true energy inside each family, then the lower of the two repeats. The repulsion penalty is not the selection value. No ground state, eigenvector of H, E0, or fidelity in the starts or the selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.pass_at_N: wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 passes and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 8 instances with both primary repeats complete

secondary_equal_param.role: reported only, not part of the verdict

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6, repeats r=0 then r=1. Within a job, nodata, K, KM standard, KM escape, then qaoa, depth 1 then 6.
